item.title: OLAP Cubes and Multidimensional Modeling with SQL Server Analysis Services.
item.description: In this article, you will learn about OLAP cubes and multidimensional modeling with SQL Server Analysis Services. This is a key concept for data analysts to understand, as it is a common way to store and analyze data in a data warehouse.
